nature: Second adaptation of plugin-wire-82bf8c4.original for testnet profile TP-1, derived from plugin-wire-82bf8c4.tp1-adapted. NOT verbatim: every message differs from the original by exactly the changes listed and the key substitution K-1, and was re-signed in one run.
publicationNote: Metadata redacted for publication on 2026-10-18; the same cases were re-signed with fresh test keys by the pinned adapter.

changes.what: response signing domain (the original signs responses under the request domain)
new exact member `profile` {id, base, chainIdentity, pinVersion} in request, response and delegation payloads
new exact member `revision` (the profile revision, "TP-1") in every profile member: {id, revision, base, chainIdentity, pinVersion}

keySubstitution.what: The pre-revision adaptation's run-time keys were discarded. Four new run-time keys replace them one for one; each message is signed by the substitute of the key that signed it there, over the same bytes of the new message, and a message that carried another message's signature carries that message's new signature. Every claim and session key in the messages is substituted the same way.
